product.title: Muir Woods and Sausalito Small-Group Tour

description.text: Half-day small-group tour from San Francisco to Muir Woods National Monument and Sausalito with transport over the Golden Gate Bridge. The itinerary includes a short scenic stop, independent time among redwoods, and free time on the Sausalito waterfront before returning to San Francisco.

highlights: Cross the Golden Gate Bridge with bay and skyline views
Visit Muir Woods National Monument with included entry
Free time to walk redwood trails and visitor areas
Explore Sausalito waterfront shops, cafes, and marina views
Small-group format in a luxury air-conditioned Mercedes Sprinter

start.description: Selected San Francisco meeting points (commonly 488 Post St or Pier 33, based on departure option).

itineraryItems.title: Golden Gate Bridge (pass-by)
itineraryItems.description: Cross the bridge en route to Marin County with commentary on Bay landmarks.

itineraryItems.title: Vista Point
itineraryItems.description: Brief stop for photos of the Golden Gate Bridge, San Francisco skyline, and Alcatraz views.

itineraryItems.title: Muir Woods National Monument
itineraryItems.description: Independent time to walk marked redwood trails and visitor areas in the monument.

itineraryItems.title: Sausalito Boardwalk
itineraryItems.description: Free time along Sausalito's waterfront district for shops, cafes, and marina scenery.

itineraryItems.title: Marin Headlands (pass-by)
itineraryItems.description: Return route passes coastal headlands with additional bay perspectives.

faqs.question: Where does this tour meet?
faqs.answer: Pickup is at selected San Francisco meeting points depending on the departure option; common points include 488 Post St and Pier 33.

faqs.question: How long is the experience?
faqs.answer: The listed duration is about 5 hours.

faqs.question: Is cancellation available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Free cancellation is available up to 24 hours before the experience starts.

additionalInfo: Free cancellation up to 24 hours in advance.
